about: Protocole d'analyse / analysis protocol. Seuils, constantes et regles de verdict de highline. Les controles C1, C2, C4, C5 ont ete fixes avant de regarder les resultats ; C3, C6, C7 sont post hoc et marques comme tels. Thresholds and verdict rules; C1, C2, C4, C5 were fixed before looking at results; C3, C6, C7 are post hoc and labelled so. `pytest tests/test_protocol.py` verifie que ce fichier est identique au code / checks that this file matches the code.

selection.block_installed: age >= 5 s and ball_x >= 35 m from the goal line
selection.line: mean of the 4 deepest outfield defenders

C1.go: median gap <= 0.10 m and >= 95% of gaps <= 0.5 m and best frame shift = 0
C1.a_voir: >= 90% of gaps <= 0.5 m and best shift = 0

C3.go: median gap to provider last_defensive_line_height_start <= 1 m

C4.go: at most 10% of placebo intervals exclude 0 (nominal 5%)

C6.stable: sign unchanged and change <= max(0.3 point, 30% of baseline)

C7.stable: sign unchanged on the moments where the 4 deepest are detected; selection gap reported, no verdict
